gaps.target: Populate hand/scribe, support, layout, damage, findspot, period and sign-variant evidence from rights-compatible sources; preserve source assertions.
Search/browse documents, signs, source-defined words, sites, disagreements and provenance with linked evidence.
Stable documented Python/API query layer over canonical evidence objects and provenance.
Validated JSON-LD, EpiDoc, Parquet and other adapters with explicit loss reports.
Bibliography/commentary linked at document/sign/claim level without reproducing restricted text.
Source-attributed site gazetteer and map/export layer with uncertainty and provenance.
Evidence-aware arithmetic/accounting checks that distinguish source numerals, fractions, damage and scholarly metrological models.
Wildcard pattern, KWIC, collocation, minimal-pair/form-family and graphotactic tools tied to reproducible evidence layers.
Link to lawful external imagery/RTI/object resources; do not ingest restricted models without permission.
Independent expert/object-level review of disputed readings and physical identities.

rule: Capability parity never licenses source copying and never upgrades computational agreement to independent epigraphic confirmation.
